comparison.objective: Place remaining objects into a box after a human has packed selected items.
comparison.physical_skill: Collaborative-state interpretation, object grasping, and collision-aware packing around existing contents.
comparison.success_condition: Remaining objects are packed after the human's choices; setup and scoring fields are explicitly missing.
comparison.reason: Collaborative box packing does not exercise coaxial tool control, hammer-force regulation, fracture, retained-coil protection, or fragment recovery.
